gather-v1.instruction: Gather relevant facts from the supplied evidence. Keep observations separate from inferences, state material gaps and uncertainties, and avoid drawing a final synthesis or proposing an experiment unless asked.

synthesis-v1.instruction: Synthesize the supplied evidence into a direct answer. Connect relevant findings, distinguish established facts from inference, and state the remaining uncertainty and its effect on the conclusion.

experiment-plan-v1.instruction: Turn the supplied question and evidence into a feasible, testable experiment plan. State the hypothesis, controls, measurements, decision criteria, and key risks; do not claim the experiment has been run.

legacy-v1.note: Explicit internal selector only. Existing callers without a policy ID retain their profile settings.

enforcement.supervisor: Accepts a known policy ID and derives every numerical limit from the registry. A policy-selected request carrying max_tokens or reasoning_mode is rejected.
enforcement.adapter: Revalidates the ID and exact registry-derived generation settings. Effective logical context is clamped to the installed service physical context. Existing deadline, token-rate, visible-answer, reasoning, and physical-context clamps remain active.
enforcement.telemetry: Reports policy ID and requested, effective, and used logical-context, reasoning-token, and visible-token budgets separately. Hidden reasoning content is not added to telemetry.
enforcement.legacy: Requests without a policy ID retain the existing profile-driven request-local adapter behavior. The qualification-only global adapter setter remains outside concurrent turn routing.

limits: Role labels select behavior budgets only and confer no tools, roots, permissions, or workspace access.
A public inquiry cannot select or supply a policy ID; the trusted controller maps its internal work type to the private ID.
The logical context budget does not change model weights, server context configuration, device placement, or the central owner and lease identity.
These CPU-source tests do not qualify live model behavior, installed engine budget adherence, GPU performance, or optimality.

checks: Distinct immutable gather, synthesis, and experiment-plan instructions are derived by private policy ID.
Concurrent gather and synthesis supervisor turns retain separate instructions and budgets.
A fake llama.cpp transport observes the trusted policy system message and proves the original input messages are unchanged.
Fake adapter telemetry records requested, effective and used context, reasoning, and visible budgets; synthetic hidden reasoning is absent from returned usage and metadata.
The supervisor rejects caller-supplied policy instructions and raw numeric budget or reasoning-mode overrides; the adapter rejects instruction/policy mismatches.
All tests run in source mode with inherited installed-release pins cleared; no model, device, or child process is started.
